text: Actions are judged by their intentions, and every person will be rewarded according to what they intended.
None of you truly believes until he wishes for his brother what he wishes for himself.
The best among you are those who are best to their families.
Smiling at your brother is an act of charity.
Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all matters.
The strong person is not the one who overpowers others, but the one who controls himself when angry.
Be mindful of Allah and He will protect you. Be mindful of Allah and you will find Him with you.
Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.
Cleanliness is half of faith.
The most beloved deeds to Allah are the ones done regularly, even if small.
Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every believer.
None of you truly believes until he wishes for his neighbour what he wishes for himself.
Modesty brings nothing except good.

Take advantage of five before five: your youth before your old age, your health before your sickness, your wealth before your poverty, your free time before you are occupied, and your life before your death.
A man asked the Prophet who most deserved his good companionship. He said: your mother — three times — then your father.
Whoever relieves a believer's hardship in this life, Allah will relieve one of his hardships on the Day of Judgment.
Feed the hungry, visit the sick, and free the captive.
A good word is charity.
Whoever guides someone to goodness has a reward like the one who does it.
Allah does not look at your bodies or your wealth, but He looks at your hearts and your deeds.
The world is a prison for the believer and a paradise for the disbeliever.
When Allah loves a servant, He calls Gabriel and says: I love so-and-so, so love him — and Gabriel loves him, then announces it in the heavens.
The believer is not one who eats his fill while his neighbour goes hungry beside him.
Whoever does not thank people has not thanked Allah.
Richness is not having many possessions, but richness is being content with oneself.
The most perfect believer in faith is the one with the best character.
Whoever removes a worldly hardship from a believer, Allah will remove from him one of the hardships of the Day of Judgment.
Verily with every hardship there is relief; verily with every hardship there is relief.
Do not belittle any good deed, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.
He who does not show mercy to others will not be shown mercy.
